design_goal.primary: Optimize a reviewed 35-position VHH CDR envelope while measuring L0/L1/L2 recovery at 28 defined reference sites and preserving the cysteines and HEWL chain.
design_goal.formal_success_definition: Increase staged recovery while preserving integrity, SAbDab VHH plausibility, and Protenix interface quality; no native identity is exposed in the case sheet or evidence catalog.

positive_signals: Exactly 35 zero-based VHH CDR positions are editable; 28 have fixed L0/L1/L2 recovery labels.
L0, L1, and L2 recovery are emitted as distinct typed evaluator terms.
Unique MCTS candidates are evaluated with ProGen, the external SAbDab ESM-2 prior, and frozen-MSA Protenix-v2 structure evidence.
High-entropy point, site-resample, and segment-mutagenesis actions make all 35 reviewed CDR positions reachable from the initial MCTS tree and reward escape from the all-alanine CDR start.
HEWL, VHH length, and C22-C96/C33-C109 cysteine identities remain unchanged.
failure_signals: Any edit outside the compiled 35-position CDR mask.
Any VHH or HEWL length change.
Any edit of HEWL or one of the four disulfide-forming cysteines.
A formal final selection missing Protenix evidence for the exact selected sequence.

information_gaps: Sequence recovery is not experimental affinity prediction.
Protenix confidence is a computational design signal; experimental affinity and activity remain unmeasured.
Native identities are evaluator-only and are not used as an LLM residue prior.
provisional_assumptions: The scientific package uses 1JTT chain-local 1-based numbering; runtime selectors are zero-based and end-exclusive.
No insertions, deletions, or chain changes are permitted.

current_structure_evaluator.tree_persistence: single inner run only; winner phenotype crosses outer memory
current_structure_evaluator.claim_boundary: structure-confidence guidance; not an affinity or experimental validation metric
current_structure_evaluator.msa: frozen paired and unpaired templates; candidate query rewritten at prediction time
